privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body:
This shelf keeps a record of what you read, what you learned, and what you choose to share.

The account
You sign in with an email and a password. Supabase holds the account. The shelf keeps the name you choose, the short note on your profile, and a picture if you add one.

What stays with you
A reading, a private study, and a growth note stay on your shelf. Other readers do not see them on this website.

What you publish
A review is public. It stays with the book: the lesson, what you are going to do, who it is for, and any stars you add. A study you mark public is shown to anyone looking at that theme and subject, including the verses you looked up.

The catalog and Scripture
Book details and covers come from Open Library. Verse text comes from the Bible translation you choose, and that text stays with its publisher. A book preview is written from the catalog. When the server has an AI key, that preview can also be written with an AI service.

Cookies
A sign-in cookie keeps you signed in on this website. The desk that manages the shelf uses a separate cookie.

How long it stays
You can change your name, your note, and your picture. A public review or a public study remains until you or the desk removes it.

The desk
The person who runs this shelf can open a desk on the same data. With the public key, that desk sees what this website already shows. Private readings, private studies, and growth notes stay hidden unless the desk is given a Supabase secret key.

This page
The text here is the current privacy notice. The date under the title is the last time it was edited.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
This website is a shelf for books and for Bible study. Creating an account, keeping a reading, or publishing a review or a study means you agree to these terms.

Your shelf
You can search the catalog, keep a reading, and write a study. A reading is your own record: want to read, reading, finished, or stopped, with the edition, the format, and how far you got.

What you publish
A review is public. Write it in your own words: the lesson, what you are going to do with it, and who it is for. A study can be private or public. A public study, including its verses and notes, is visible to anyone on that subject.

Your responsibility
Publish only what you have the right to share. Do not post another person's private writing, and do not use the shelf to harass anyone. Scripture quotations remain with their publishers. Book descriptions and covers remain with their sources.

Removal
The person who runs this shelf may remove a review, a reading, or a study, and may make a public study private. You can change your profile and remove your picture.

The service
The catalog can be incomplete. A preview is a help before you commit to a book. It is not a copy of the book. The shelf can be unavailable while the website or Supabase is being set up.

These terms
The text on this page is the text that applies. It can be updated from the desk. The date under the title is the date of the last edit.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body:
You can ask for your account on this shelf to be removed. This page says what that removal covers.

What is removed
The account, the name, the short note, and the picture. Readings, private studies, and growth notes go with the account. Public reviews and public studies are removed as well, so they no longer appear on a book or a study subject.

What stays
Book records in the catalog stay, because other readers may still be using them. Open Library covers and descriptions stay with their source. Scripture quotations stay with their publishers.

How to ask
Write to the person who runs this shelf and name the email on the account. The desk can remove the account and the records listed above. Until that is done, a public review or a public study remains visible.
